question.nlq: I would like to know, for each city, the three tallest buildings that are under construction, together with the name of the company occupying each building (if any), and the rank of each building by height within its city.

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH ranked AS (
    SELECT b."City" AS city,
           b."name" AS building_name,
           b."Height",
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY b."City" ORDER BY b."Height" DESC) AS rn,
           ol."company_id"
    FROM "buildings" b
    LEFT JOIN "Office_locations" ol ON b.id = ol.building_id
    WHERE b."Status" = 'under construction'
)
SELECT r.city,
       r.building_name,
       c."name" AS company_name,
       r.rn AS rank
FROM ranked r
LEFT JOIN "Companies" c ON r.company_id = c.id
WHERE r.rn <= 3
ORDER BY r.city, r.rn;

question.nlq: Could you tell me which companies occupy more than one building, and for each such company list the names of the buildings they are in ordered by height descending, together with the earliest move‑in year, the latest move‑in year, and the total number of years between those moves?

meanings.gt_sql:
WITH company_stats AS (
    SELECT o.company_id,
           MIN(o.move_in_year) AS earliest_year,
           MAX(o.move_in_year) AS latest_year,
           (MAX(o.move_in_year) - MIN(o.move_in_year)) AS years_between
    FROM Office_locations o
    GROUP BY o.company_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.building_id) > 1
),
company_buildings AS (
    SELECT o.company_id,
           b.name AS building_name,
           b."Height" AS building_height,
           o.move_in_year
    FROM Office_locations o
    JOIN buildings b ON o.building_id = b.id
)
SELECT c.name AS company_name,
       cb.building_name,
       cs.earliest_year,
       cs.latest_year,
       cs.years_between
FROM company_stats cs
JOIN Companies c ON cs.company_id = c.id
JOIN company_buildings cb ON cb.company_id = cs.company_id
ORDER BY c.name, cb.building_height DESC;

FROM Companies c

JOIN buildings b ON ol.building_id = b.id

),
stats AS (
    SELECT company_id,
           company_name,
           COUNT(DISTINCT building_name) AS building_cnt,
           MIN(move_in_year) AS earliest_move,
           MAX(move_in_year) AS latest_move,
           (MAX(move_in_year) - MIN(move_in_year)) AS years_between
    FROM cb

    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT building_name) > 1
)
SELECT s.company_name,
       GROUP_CONCAT(cb.building_name, ', ' ORDER BY cb.Height DESC) AS buildings,
       s.earliest_move,
       s.latest_move,
       s.years_between
FROM stats s
JOIN cb ON s.company_id = cb.company_id
GROUP BY s.company_id, s.company_name, s.earliest_move, s.latest_move, s.years_between;

WITH company_buildings AS (

  JOIN Buildings b ON ol.building_id = b.id
